$comment: Provenance and LICENCE for the model this repository ships a binary of.
It is the same kind of record as testdata/labels.json, for the same reason: a
measurement whose input nobody can account for is a number that may not be
quoted. This one exists because the FILENAME is wrong.
It is written beside the measured contract and not beside the weights because
`models/` is gitignored. `/models/` holds 257 MB of weights that are not in
this repository, and a licence note inside a gitignored directory is a note
nobody reviewing the repository will ever read. The contract this file points
at IS committed, so this is the committed half of the same record.
sha256: NOT RECORDED - compute it with `certutil -hashfile models\yolov8n.onnx SHA256` and put it here before this weights file is shown to anyone outside this machine
why_the_filename_is_wrong: The measured export has 85 fields per detection, which means there is an
objectness at column 4. A YOLOv8 export has 84 (4 box + 80 class) and no
It publishes THREE outputs at strides 52, 26 and 13 over a 416x416 NHWC
input. That is one output per stride, i.e. anchored. A YOLOv8 export is
fused: one output, no anchor boxes.
decoder_family is `anchored` in the contract and the file needs
`models/yolov8n.anchors.txt`, which lives in the model's .cfg and is not in
the ONNX file. A YOLOv8 needs no anchors at all.
names_verbatim is EMPTY. The export carries no class metadata, so the
decoder falls back to the COCO-80 vocabulary by index.
licence: NOT RECORDED. This is the open item, and it is the one that matters.
licence_consequence: The weights were NOT obtained through Ultralytics' published download page,
and this repository has no record of where they came from at all. Nothing in
the commit history or in `pocctl fetch-model`'s default URL names an origin.
IF the weights are Ultralytics', the licence is AGPL-3.0, and Ultralytics'
own licensing page states that commercial use and internal use require an
Enterprise licence. That would put a licence obligation on the DEMONSTRATION
and a much larger one on anything derived from it.
IF the weights are from the ONNX Model Zoo under a permissive licence, the
The two are not distinguishable from anything in this repository, so no claim
is made either way. The record says NOT RECORDED because NOT RECORDED is
cleared_for: measurement, on this machine, for the POC's own evaluation
NOT_cleared_for: any product derived from these weights
a claim that the POC may be shipped commercially

measured_with.measured_on: one frame from a night traffic camera, on a CPU-only machine
measured_with.note: the decode telemetry in the contract was measured on that one frame, not over a corpus. The collapsed-decode fix is proven by the shape (identical_geometry 0, median_box_area 0.0015) and by 40+ cases in pyworker/test_decode.py, not by this frame alone.

decisions.rename: NO. F5.2: a rename without a licence change moves the problem. Renaming the file to yolov4 would make the filename honest and leave the licence unrecorded, which is the same defect with a nicer label.
decisions.replacement_model: a separate, named decision, once the licence of what ships today is known

actions_before_this_weight_is_used_outsi: record the sha256 above, so the file is identified by its content and not by a name
record the true origin URL and the retrieval date
record the licence, verbatim, from the licence file or page the weights came with
if it is Ultralytics, either obtain an Enterprise licence or replace the weights
